title: Pan-Seared Australian Spring Onions with Skillet-Seared Unique Onions
description: A flavorful and savory side dish featuring the sweetness of spring onions and unique onions, seared to perfection in a skillet.
instructions: Heat glassy oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the unique onions and sear for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until caramelized.
Add the Australian spring onions to the skillet and sear for an additional 2 minutes, or until slightly softened.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the onions hot, garnished with additional spring onions if desired.
